## Summary

Describe the change and why it is useful to the SNNCommunity.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] Documentation or tutorial
- [ ] Research resource or citation
- [ ] Reproducibility or benchmark information
- [ ] Maintenance, bug fix, or tooling
- [ ] Community process improvement

## Evidence and checks

- [ ] I reviewed the changed files and links.
- [ ] I cited primary sources for factual research claims where applicable.
- [ ] I documented reproducibility limitations where applicable.
- [ ] I have permission to share any included code, data, and media.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, or confidential review materials.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, discussion, experiments, and known limitations.
